name: known-knobs
description: Settle the remaining well-known llama.cpp knobs on this card in one pass, cheapest first, each as a normal locked A/B against the current best. The build-changing step comes last. Vulkan is left out: it needs the Vulkan SDK on the laptop and its own kernel check.

steps.hypothesis: GGML_CUDA_GRAPH_OPT=1 changes balanced performance at full offload.
Capturing the whole graph as one CUDA graph (GGML_CUDA_GRAPH_CHUNK_SIZE=0) changes decode speed.
ubatch 256 (from 512) changes prompt speed or VRAM.
With full offload, 2 CPU threads match the default and use less energy.
Loading without mmap (load mode none) lowers host RSS without slowing inference.
cuBLAS instead of MMQ for prompt batches (-DGGML_CUDA_FORCE_CUBLAS=ON) is slower on Pascal.
